# Large Document Corpus Review Service

Capability ID: large-document-corpus-review-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/large-document-corpus-review-v1/index.html
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

## Use this when

- review thousands of documents
- analyze a document dump
- deduplicate a large document set
- map a public records production
- large legal document review

## Problem

Large public or authorized document productions are expensive to index, map, deduplicate and review without losing provenance.

## Inputs

Public or owner-authorized corpus, review question/scope and applicable privilege/privacy boundaries.

## Outputs

Corpus ingestion, subdocument mapping, deduplication, evidence index and review packets with provenance.

## Pricing

Current hypothesis $1,500-$25,000/project depending on corpus size/scope; not auto-quotable yet.

## Invocation and authority

Discoverable capability; upload/payment disabled pending rights/security verification.

Only public or owner-authorized corpora. Paid scope and privileged handling require explicit authorization.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
